err.service: The service is not responding — try again in a moment.
err.offline: No connection — the file was not sent.
err.tooBig: A file sent by link can be at most 25 MB.
err.unreadable: Could not read the file — is it really a file and not a folder?
err.missing: This file does not exist — it was deleted or the link is incomplete.
err.unreachable: No connection to recreatio.pl — try again.

file.incomplete: This link is incomplete — check that it was copied in full.
file.broken: This link is damaged or incomplete — the file cannot be decrypted.
file.patience: Please be patient: the file is being downloaded and decrypted here, in your browser. A large file may take a while.
file.note: The file is encrypted. The key is only in this link — recreatio.pl does not know it. Anyone with this link can open the file.

queue.noClipboard: This browser does not allow copying — select the link and copy it by hand.
queue.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the link and copy it by hand.

view.title: Files by link
view.removeBody: The link stops working at once — also for those who already got it.
view.removed: Deleted — the link no longer works.
view.intro: Photos and files as a link — added here, sent in an SMS or from Thunderbird — in full quality, encrypted. The key is only in the link; recreatio.pl does not know it. After the deadline the file disappears by itself.
view.drop: Drop, and every file gets a link (valid {days})
view.empty: No files by link yet. Add a file above — or attach a photo or file in an SMS conversation and choose „Link — full quality”, or connect Thunderbird (below).

add.title: New link to a file
add.noteTouch: Every file (up to 25 MB) gets its own link.
add.note: Or drag files onto the page or paste them (Ctrl+V). Every file (up to 25 MB) gets its own link.

conn.dropBody: New attachments will no longer go out from here as a link. Files sent earlier work until their deadline — delete them in the list above.
conn.dropped: Disconnected — this Thunderbird will no longer add files.
conn.intro: Large attachments in Thunderbird can go as the same kind of link — encrypted before they leave the computer, visible here in the list. Thunderbird does not sign in to your account: it gets a code that only allows adding files and deleting those it added itself.
conn.old: The recreatio.pl service does not support this yet — it will be possible after its update.
conn.codeFailed: Could not create the connection code.
conn.codeCopyFailed: Could not copy — select the code and copy it by hand.
conn.name: Connection name
conn.step1: Install the add-on recreatio-filelink.xpi in Thunderbird: Add-ons and Themes → ⚙ → Install Add-on From File.
conn.step3: Paste this code and click „Connect”. The code is shown only now — don't send it to anyone: whoever has it can add files to your account.
conn.title: Thunderbird
